scientific_review.object: Training sample, fixed learning rule and training, trained model, prediction and independent evaluation sample
findings: Historical mail is checked by a person before training; pictures are illustrative, not numerical evidence.
The trained model predicts on a new mail; evaluation uses labeled independent records and does not supply training labels.
People and mail icons are schematic; colors do not alone establish correct labels.

visual_review.layout: Three equally spaced, purposeful scenes; labels below the artwork; single body column.
